verdict.rationale: The pack holds substantial extracted text from both the public homepage (https://www.impots.gouv.fr/) and the /professionnel landing page: service links, FAQ questions, reform notices and even the theme-switcher label. That implies these pages were fetched and returned real server-rendered content, not a JS-only shell, bot wall or CAPTCHA. This is indirect evidence, not a documented access policy. Missing for 10: confirmation that the fetch used a keyless, standard identified user agent; evidence that deeper guidance pages (e.g. the e-invoicing guide, rescrits, tutorials) are equally reachable; any published robots or bot-access policy or independent crawl corroboration.
